title: Tell Me Your Dream Game Ideas
author: Haman24
selftext: If you could what game would you make? I think I'd go with a more mellow, cozy winter game, cabin coffee cafe in the woods type

comments.author: jildos_legoplanet
comments.body: I’m working on a viking sim where you grow a lineage in a community. Each inhabitant has its own DNA which dominant traits are carried over to their kin. First simulations give a promising gameplay.

comments.author: gimmetwofingers
comments.body:
I think about this game since I was a teenager.  It is a strategy game, you have to liberate a medieval fantasy world from the occupying orc hordes. 
At the beginning you are the captain of a small group of outlaws, commanding just a couple of wannabe fighters. Over time you liberate more and more of the world and your group evolves into a large army and you into a general or warlord. The game has two layers, one is a turn based strategy layer, where you manage the liberated part of the world, take care of the economy, send scouts and armies. The other layer is RTS, where you resolve battles, where you personally are present. 
I want to strike a good balance between realism and RTS fun. There will be no god-like player. Everything around the player avatar is classic RTS, but you cannot control units that are two far away. For this you can give general commands ("flank the enemy from the west", "capture and hold that hill").
I build this game at the moment, but I'm broke at the moment, so I only use tokens in my monthly allowance. Let's see, when I will have a demo.

comments.author: _Raro
comments.body:
Skyrim / kenshi style game but much larger and completely dynamic. Each NPC is autonomous and carries out a daily routine and RP's as their character.

Time passes and events happen dynamically. the world does not wait for you, there can be entire wars happening without you.

The game designer would just set the starting conditions of the world and let it play out from their with everything reacting to your involvement.
